name: Plateau tea
summary: Plateau tea is the cup from the hills. Vietnam Tourism sends visitors to Moc Suong for an old tea ceremony and to watch the leaf being processed, and a summer note names premium oolong. A 2019 Bao Son La feature says the hills include older plantings and newer oolong. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: Tân Lập and Mộc Sương. Vietnam Tourism, and Bao Son La, 26 December 2019.
howToEat: Drink it at the tea ground, in daylight. A ceremony script beyond Vietnam Tourism’s line is Check on arrival.

The 2019 feature says Moc Chau tea is less famous than Thai Nguyen tea. Vietnam Tourism’s older line that calls the hills the largest tea region is not settled by that feature. The drink is the cup either way.
The fee and the price of a cup are Check on arrival. Do not reuse the 2019 line that the hills charged no ticket.
where: Tân Lập for the rows. Mộc Sương for the processing visit and the ceremony. Bao Son La’s 2016 feature also lists chè among foods to carry home.
seoDescription: Moc Chau tea is the hill cup, with a ceremony at Moc Suong and oolong named by Vietnam Tourism. A cup price is Check on arrival.
